title: Not great
text: I feel like I’m not actually learning how to code… they have set up a website so that certain keys mean certain pictures or backgrounds or audio show up when you type it in. I am more interested in how they set that up!! I don’t feel like I could do any type of coding after using two of these Boxes. I also don’t find it very fun. The apps don’t do much at all… They aren’t even real apps. Even for a kid I don’t see the appeal :-(
label: negative
